items.html: A second matter was also explained: that the most praiseworthy discernment of all of them, which is the Atik Yomin of Atzilut, was sorted at the beginning of everything; and while it was being sorted for the need of Atik Yomin, no other discernment was being sorted at all. And at the completion of the sorting of the portion of Atik Yomin, then began the sorting of the portion of AA; and likewise in this manner, until the completion of the sorting of the entire world of Atzilut. And after the completion of the sorting of the entire world of Atzilut, then began the sorting of the world of Beriah, in the order of the Partzufim in it, in the manner that we explained in Atzilut; and likewise in this manner it was afterward in Yetzirah, and afterward in Assiyah. And also this second matter is in the general, and in the particular, and in the particular of the particular.
